items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: He's been working with Benny quite a bit over the past year-and-a-half or so.

ctx.x: Yes, he's teaching. And he works. He's been working with Benny quite a bit over the past year-and-a-half or so. But Benny I guess didn't speak to him for about fifteen years or something, and then suddenly they got together again. Slim had a lot of things that remind me of Leo Watson a bit...
